entities.summary: KELT-4Ab is an extrasolar planet that orbits the star KELT-4A, in the star system KELT-4. The planet is approximately 760 ly (230 pc) away in the constellation of Leo. The planet was discovered by the Kilodegree Extremely Little Telescope (KELT).
